messages:
harper: Quick sync  we need to shift the v2 canary slices this week. EU region had a capacity spike and slice-B latency is spiking at 95th. Proposal: move B -> C for the next 48h, bump canary percent from 5% -> 15%, and land a small SDK hotpatch that fixes header parsing for the /v2/embeddings route. Owners and blockers?
kevin: Which services are impacted? Is this likely to break v1 clients or just v2-only flows?
harper: Only the server-side embedding generation path (v2 embeddings). v1 still goes through the shim so should be unaffected. The hotpatch is strictly parsing resilience + a timeout tweak.
jessica: I can own the SDK hotpatch and release. I'll open a draft PR and tag reviewers. Can someone paste the minimal curl test I should run for the smoke?
alok: Putting the slice change here  we should update the routing config and the autoscale policy for slice C. Quick snippet for the routing API: ```PUT /routing/slices HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "slice_updates": [
    {"from": "slice-B", "to": "slice-C", "duration": "48h"},
    {"canary_percent": 15}
  ]
}``` Run that from infra account (svc-router).
sara: I'll take canary metrics & evals. I'll wire up the canary ML eval set and a regression alert set for answer quality and token delta. Will post the dashboard links before the switch.
kevin: Also add a quick smoke check for the embedding shape/length and header passthrough. Something like: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/embeddings 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{"model":"open-embedding-1","input":"test input","top_k":1}'```
jessica: Thanks, running that now in my env. PR at https://git.redwood/infrakit/sdk-js/pulls/1899 - it's a tiny change in headers.js to accept both string and array forms and to preserve unknown headers. Putting reviewers: @maria @kevin.
maria: Quick check  we need to coordinate release window with mobile SDKs. Mobile has a scheduled build tonight; can we hold the npm publish until 0200 UTC?
jessica: Yes — I'll draft the release and hold merge until after 0200 UTC. Will post the npm tag and the changelog.
deploy-bot: deploy started: routing-update-3923456789 by svc-router at 3923459200
harper: Noted. Please also enable fallback routing to region-us as a safety net for 10 minutes after cutover.
alok: fallback toggle: ```POST /routing/fallbacks HTTP/1.1
{
  "enable": true,
  "regions": ["region-us"],
  "duration": "10m"
}```
kevin: If we see increased 5xxs, roll back the slice update. Also please confirm tracing headers are preserved in the shim path (x-rw-trace).
sara: Dashboard links: Canary metrics -> https://grafana.redwood/d/embeds-canary | Eval results -> https://ml.redwood/qa/canary-run/3923456789 | I'll post a short readout at +30m.
jessica: npm pre-release done, tag preview/v2-emb-headerfix. Holding merge.
deploy-bot: routing-update-3923456789 succeeded at 3923459350
harper: Cutover looks green so far. 95th latency dropped from 560ms -> 210ms for slice-C. Sara, curious about regen quality diffs.
sara: Quick readout: embedding cosine deltas within baseline 0.01 for 98% of samples, token delta within expected. No regressions so far.
maria: Mobile build finished fine. No issues in integration smoke. You can merge after 0205 UTC.
jessica: Merged and published npm @redwood/sdk-js@2.1.3-rc1 at 3923460000. Changelog: fixes header parsing, preserves unknown headers, bump timeout to 8s for embeddings.
kevin: Thx all. Follow-ups: 
- harper to verify post-cutover incident channels are monitored for 2h
- alok to revert fallback after 10m window
- sara to run a second canary eval in 6h and post results
- jessica to cut a release note for the platform changelog
harper: I'll monitor for 2h and update the incidents channel if anything pops. Great job folks :thumbsup:
maria: one more ask  can we add a compatibility note for mobile in the SDK changelog mentioning header behavior? small blurb is fine.
jessica: Adding that now to the changelog entry. Will ping marketing for release blurb.
sara: second eval scheduled for +6h. Will share results in this thread.
kevin: Closing loop: anyone need a follow-up async ticket? If not I'll mark this canary as in-progress until sara's 6h eval.
harper: No further blockers. Mark in-progress. Thanks everyone.
